formal function definitions.min_height:
fun min_height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "min_height Leaf = 0" |
  "min_height (Node l _ r) = min (min_height l) (min_height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.map_tree:
primrec map_tree :: "('a ⇒ 'b) ⇒ 'a tree ⇒ 'b tree" where
  "map_tree f Leaf = Leaf" |
  "map_tree f (Node l x r) = (Node (map_tree f l) (f x) (map_tree f r))"

formal theorem statement: theorem min_height_map_tree[simp]: "min_height (map_tree f t) = min_height t"
